notes: §2002:14.8.35.3 GR2a.1: an arithmetic-expression-1 that is not a valid subscript (8.4.1.2.3 GR2: outside 1 through the highest permissible occurrence number) sets EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT, the SET is unsuccessful and the receiving index-name unchanged. SetEmitter.EmitSetTo tests each index-name receiver through CobolIndex.WithinTable where EditionInfo.SetIndexOutsideTableIsSubscriptError (2002 alone; 2014 and 2023 word the range as EC-RANGE-INDEX only) and only for an arithmetic-expression sender (GR2a.2 and GR2a.3 place the content unchanged). With checking not enabled the outcome is implementor-defined and the value is stored (D-SET-INDEX-UNCHECKED). kb/Work PB5674.
